security_audit.summary: The static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and JavaScript template literals. The hardcoded URLs are official Telegram endpoints or placeholders for examples. I found one substantive issue: the skill shows initDataUnsafe user access but does not include backend initData validation.

remediation.issue: The skill shows initDataUnsafe user access without a complete backend validation pattern.
remediation.suggestion: Add Telegram initData HMAC validation and warn that initDataUnsafe is not authentication proof.

content.user_title: Build Telegram Mini Apps With TON
content.value_statement: Telegram Mini Apps require platform APIs, mobile UX, payments, and TON wallet patterns. This skill gives concise patterns for setup, monetization, referrals, and launch planning.
actual_capabilities: Explains Telegram Web App API setup and bot entry points.
Provides React hook patterns for Telegram WebApp access.
Shows TON Connect UI concepts and manifest requirements.
Outlines Telegram Stars invoices and monetization options.
Describes referral mechanics, retention ideas, and UX anti-patterns.
Lists sharp edges for authentication, mobile wallets, performance, and buttons.
limitations: Does not include a complete runnable application.
Does not provide backend Telegram initData validation code.
Uses placeholder domains that developers must replace.
Payment and wallet examples need review against current Telegram and TON docs.

use_cases.title: Prototype a Mini App
use_cases.description: Plan the first mobile-first Telegram flow with Web App API setup and bot entry points.

use_cases.title: Add TON Payments
use_cases.description: Map wallet connection, TON transactions, and Stars purchases before implementation.

use_cases.title: Improve Retention
use_cases.description: Review referral, daily reward, and Telegram-native UX ideas for a launch plan.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Mini App
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Telegram Mini App for [use case]. Include bot entry points, Web App API setup, and mobile-first UX requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Add Telegram Features
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Mini App concept. Suggest Telegram MainButton, theme, loading, and sharing patterns that fit the user flow.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Payments and Wallets
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation plan for TON Connect and Telegram Stars in my Mini App. Include trust boundaries and validation checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate my Mini App launch plan for authentication, payment safety, performance, referrals, and Telegram platform compliance.

output_examples.input: I need a first plan for a Telegram quiz Mini App.
output_examples.output: A concise launch outline with bot entry flow, mobile screens, Telegram API setup, and retention ideas.

output_examples.input: I want to add TON wallet payments.
output_examples.output: A payment plan covering wallet connection, transaction flow, manifest needs, and validation checkpoints.

output_examples.input: My Mini App feels slow inside Telegram.
output_examples.output: A performance review with loading states, Telegram frame constraints, and mobile testing actions.

best_practices: Validate Telegram initData on the backend before trusting identity or payments.
Design mobile-first screens that follow Telegram theme colors and native controls.
Replace placeholder domains with verified production URLs before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not trust initDataUnsafe as proof of identity.
Do not design desktop-first flows for Telegram users.
Do not launch payment or referral flows without abuse checks.

faq.question: Does this skill build a complete Mini App?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and planning help. You still need to implement, host, and test the app.

faq.question: Does it support TON Connect?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains wallet connection concepts, manifest needs, and transaction flow planning.

faq.question: Can it help with Telegram Stars?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines invoice-based Stars purchases and monetization options.

faq.question: Does it validate Telegram authentication?
faq.answer: No. It mentions validation risk but lacks a full backend validation example.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Should I keep the placeholder URLs?
faq.answer: No. Replace every placeholder with a verified domain that you control.
